title: How to Change or Correct Your BVN Name in Nigeria
excerpt: Correct a spelling error, marriage surname, or inverted name order on your BVN with valid legal documents and an approved online process.
keywords: how to change BVN name online

sections.content: Discovering that your name is misspelled or scrambled on your Bank Verification Number (BVN) record is one of the most frustrating barriers to financial access in Nigeria. Whether a single letter was typed incorrectly by an enrolment officer years ago or you have recently married and changed your surname, a name mismatch between your BVN and your National Identification Number (NIN) will trigger automated account restrictions. To inspect the exact name currently registered on your central banking profile, you can retrieve your verified BVN slip online.

sections.title: Need to Correct Your BVN Name Without Bank Delays?
sections.content: Do not let typographical errors freeze your bank accounts or block important transactions. Submit your lawful name modification online via the Ufriends IT BVN Modification Portal to enjoy rapid processing without taking days off work to queue at bank branches.

Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) regulations allow customers to rectify legitimate typographical errors and lawful surname changes when supported by genuine civil documentation. However, navigating this process traditionally meant taking a whole day off work, visiting a High Court for affidavits, and queueing for hours at the bank branch where you first registered your BVN. Modern digital portals now make this process entirely seamless.

items: Valid National ID: An official National Identification Number (NIN) slip displaying the intended legal name spelling and order.
Marriage Certificate: Required for women updating their surname following marriage.
Sworn Affidavit: A sworn affidavit of change of name or correction of error from a recognized court of competent jurisdiction.
Newspaper Publication: Required for substantial name changes in a widely circulated Nigerian daily national newspaper.
Original BVN Number: Your 11-digit BVN correctly recorded on the application form.

sections.content: BVN and NIN Name Mismatch Resolution

CBN directives mandate that all commercial banks cross-verify customer data between the NIBSS BVN repository and the NIMC National Identity database. If there is a single-letter discrepancy between both systems, automated financial operations will reject the transaction. The proper protocol is to identify which database contains the typographical error and update it so both platforms reflect identical spelling. If your NIN is the record containing errors, use the Ufriends NIN Modification Service.

Once your BVN name change is approved centrally on NIBSS, you should generate an updated official BVN slip with photo. Present this slip to any commercial bank where your account remains restricted so they can trigger an instant profile refresh on their internal ledger.

items.q: Can I correct just one misspelled letter in my BVN name?
items.a: Yes! Minor typographical corrections (e.g., correcting an extra or missing letter) are supported with a valid NIN slip showing the intended spelling.

items.q: Does updating my BVN name change my 11-digit number?
items.a: No. Your 11-digit BVN is a permanent biometric anchor and never changes. Only your demographic name record is updated.

items.q: Can I do a BVN name correction online without going to a bank?
items.a: Yes! The Ufriends IT BVN Modification Portal enables you to submit your verified evidence and complete your name change completely online from your mobile phone.

items.q: What happens after my BVN name is updated?
items.a: Once updated centrally on NIBSS, you can print a fresh BVN slip from Ufriends IT and notify your bank to refresh their local customer profile, instantly lifting any KYC holds.
